v2_duress_flow.what_it_proves: normal PIN unlocks; duress PIN looks like success but encrypts; owner recovers byte-identical; wrong passphrase rejected; decrypt refuses unencrypted data; partition panic marker armed/cancelled

v3_startup_watchdog.what_it_proves: baseline, confirm, timely check-in; lapsed confirmation warns and touches nothing; first missed heartbeat recorded; second missed heartbeat = final decision (encrypt); owner recovers; clean shutdown not counted

v4_off_device_watcher.what_it_proves: device checks in; goes dark -> server flags MISSED; owner arms remotely; device poll runs duress actions (encrypt); owner recovers; command consumed

versions.v1: duress PIN core + BitLocker drive protection + recovery-key backup
versions.v2: encrypt-on-duress (Fernet), configurable targets, pre-boot panics, logon monitor
versions.v3: startup watchdog: dead-man's switch + tamper counter
versions.v4: off-device watcher: remote check-in, missed detection, remote arm
